title: Better Dappled Forest
description: This pack aims to upgrade the Dappled Forest without the sacrifice of the vanilla vibe!
body:
# Better Dappled Forest 🍂

This datapack aims to upgrade the Dappled Forest whilst keeping everything within the vanilla vibe by bringing some nice foresty vibe

- Increased frequency of tree spawning
- Increased amount of spruce trees
- Added "fancy" variants for each poplar tree color replacing them around 10% of the time
- Added wildflowers
- Added ferns
- Added berry bushes
- Added granite rocks spawning occasionally in larger group
